title: Darnold perseveres through injury, doubt in SB win

sources.name: ESPN NFL
sources.title: Darnold perseveres through injury, doubt in SB win
sources.description: A victorious Seahawks locker room lauded the team's "unwavering" quarterback, Sam Darnold, whose steadiness through injury and turnover-related adversity this season culminated in a Super Bowl LX victory.
